description: Checkout service with basket validation, optional product recommendations, and payment processing.

dependencies.name: recommendations
dependencies.notes: Optional product suggestions lookup. Shares a connection pool with the primary payment provider.

dependencies.name: payments
dependencies.notes: Read-only probe checks authorisation latency. Latency above 1000ms indicates primary payment provider degradation saturating the shared pool.

retrospective.unresolved: Make checkout tolerate recommendation outages; the recommendation dependency itself was not repaired.

allowed_actions.tradeoff: Payments route through backup provider while primary provider remains degraded.

retrospective.summary: Checkout recovered; payments are running on the backup provider.
retrospective.unresolved: The primary payment provider is still degraded and was not repaired; decide when to switch back, and stop recommendation lookups sharing the payment connection pool.
retrospective.followUp: Isolate the recommendation client's connection pool from the payment provider.
